info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Subscribes-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Subscription API provides users with access to a list of subscribers for weather alerts. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve information about individuals and organizations that have opted to receive notifications regarding severe weather conditions. Typical consumers of this API include weather service providers, app developers, and businesses that need to inform their customers about safety-related weather events. By using this endpoint, users can enhance their applications with timely weather alerts and improve community safety.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to subscribe to alerts, enabling real-time notifications based on specified criteria. Users can receive important updates that are relevant to them.
